title: Prove square-root stability for complete qutrit MUBs (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped written mathematical proof with an exact finite linear-algebra certificate. Resolve David Ganz's PR #2849 atlas question B096 for four already unitary qutrit bases:

```diff
- proposed bound: dist(U,O) <= C Delta^(1/4), unproved in B096
+ proved bound:   dist(U,O) <= (2/sqrt(3)) sqrt(Delta)
+ valid whenever Delta <= epsilon for some positive, uncomputed epsilon
```

Here Delta is the sum of the 54 squared unbiasedness residuals, and distance is product Frobenius distance to the standard family's B074 equivalence orbit. The exact differential has rank 16, equivalence kernel dimension 20, and all sixteen normal squared singular values equal 3. A compact tubular-neighborhood argument supplies the error bound. Brierley, Weigert and Bengtsson's complete-family uniqueness theorem is a cited premise, not an audit deliverable or a new classification claim.

Only `research/qutrit-mub-stability/` is added. The contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit David Ganz for B096/B074 and the qualitative compactness argument, and Brierley, Weigert and Bengtsson for complete-family uniqueness and the standard representative. [Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19146051).

## Evidence

Before, B096 had qualitative repair and an explicitly unproved power exponent. The new proof uses an exact Q(omega) differential: a nonzero 16-by-16 minor has determinant -64/2187; 21 equivalence directions span its 20-dimensional kernel; all 1296 entries of `K W^-1 K = 3K` hold; 972 derivative entries agree in separately derived left/right tangent coordinates.

Local CPython 3.12.2 normal/optimized replays and all seven rejection controls pass. Registered checks take 0.257, 0.250 and 1.504 seconds individually, single-run timeout measurements. Metadata, committed-byte/source-history preflight, official export and export integrity pass. Every registered command also passes from the committed read-only Git-free export in 0.250, 0.251 and 1.513 seconds; all 11 exported files remain unchanged. No predecessor executable was replayed as the contribution.

Reproduce from the repository root with the exact local interpreter, or substitute another CPython 3.12 executable:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -Werror -B research/qutrit-mub-stability/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/qutrit-mub-stability/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/qutrit-mub-stability/test_package.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/qutrit-mub-stability
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/qutrit-mub-stability --check-source-history
```

Set TMPDIR to owned external scratch storage for the corruption controls. The verifier reports `PASS_QUTRIT_MUB_STABILITY`; the controls report `PASS_QUTRIT_MUB_CONTROLS rejected=7`.

## Limitations

The threshold epsilon is existential. No effective neighborhood, nearest-family algorithm, nonunitary-input repair, other-dimensional theorem, native supplier, new kappa or complete multiplication theorem is claimed. The differential certificate is exact software-checked linear algebra; the smooth argument is written mathematics. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review and global literature priority are unclaimed. Lean, Docker and selected-construction cold replay were not run.

## Open next questions

- Compute an explicit admissible epsilon, beginning with uniform second-derivative bounds and a quantitative separation outside the local orbit tube.
- Construct a certified local repair algorithm with a proved initialization radius. The present theorem establishes existence only.

## Related open work

No other open PR studying qutrit complete-MUB residual stability was identified in the live and cached overlap checks. PR #2849 is the merged predecessor that states the question. Other-dimensional MUB classification and line-count work concern different quantities. Coverage includes 342 open PR bodies and 4452 Discussion records refreshed at 13:01 UTC, targeted merged/main-tree searches and recent account work; sparse local-note and unpublished-work coverage is incomplete.
